description:
We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytically minded Financial Analyst to join our FP&A and Commissions team at Transfr!

This is a unique opportunity to be part of a fast-growing team and have a direct impact on the company’s financial planning, reporting, and revenue operations. In this role, you will help bring clarity to complex financial data, strengthen our forecasting processes, and ensure the accuracy of our sales commission operations.

The ideal candidate is a data-driven problem solver who enjoys connecting the dots across systems, uncovering insights, and translating complex financial information into clear, actionable insights. You are naturally curious, highly organized, and comfortable navigating a fast-paced environment where accuracy and attention to detail matter. You thrive on untangling complex processes and finding opportunities to improve efficiency through smarter reporting and automation.

As a Financial Analyst, you will be pivotal in strengthening our financial operations, improving the accuracy and efficiency of recurring processes, and providing leadership with the insights needed to guide business performance and growth. You will own key components of our monthly sales commission process and support our financial planning and analysis activities, including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial reporting. You will partner cross-functionally with Finance, Sales, RevOps, and department leaders to ensure accurate financial data, provide meaningful insights, and support informed business decisions.

Location: This position is 100% remote and can sit anywhere in the US. (Candidates in EST timezone preferred.)

The base salary range for this position is $80,000-$100,000. Actual compensation may vary based on factors including experience, skills, education, location,and internal equity considerations. This role is also eligible for our company equity program.

Day to Day Responsibilities:

  • Sales Commissions: Calculate, validate, and administer monthly sales commissions in CaptivateIQ, while managing the process from initial data preparation through final payout.

  • Partner with Sales and RevOps to address commission-related questions, resolve disputes, and maintain clear documentation of commission plans, rules, and processes.

  • Prepare and deliver commission payout files to Payroll and accurately record commission expenses and accruals during month-end close.

  • Financial Planning & Analysis: Pull monthly actuals from NetSuite and maintain budget-to-actual reporting across departments.

  • Research financial variances, collaborate with budget owners to gather explanations, and prepare variance commentary for the Controller's review.

  • Maintain and update headcount and vendor spend trackers to support ongoing financial forecasting.

  • Support the annual budgeting process and quarterly re-forecasts by collecting department inputs and preparing supporting financial schedules.

  • Prepare financial charts, analyses, and supporting schedules for leadership and board reporting.

  • Conduct ad hoc financial analysis related to pricing, contracts, and cost trends to support business decisions.

  • Identify opportunities to streamline, automate, and improve recurring spreadsheets and reporting processes to reduce manual work and minimize errors.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to improve data accuracy, reporting consistency, and financial visibility across the organization.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.

  • 2–4 years of experience in FP&A, financial analysis, or accounting, ideally within a SaaS or subscription-based business.

  • Experience working with SQL databases or extracting and analyzing data across multiple systems.

  • Experience with CaptivateIQ or another sales commission management platform.

  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, including lookups, pivot tables, and building financial models from scratch.

  • Working knowledge of ERP and CRM systems, such as NetSuite and Salesforce.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to trace financial data back to its source and understand how different systems and processes connect.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy, reconciliation, and documentation.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain financial information and insights to non-finance stakeholders.

  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and consistently meet monthly reporting and close deadlines in a fully remote environment.

  • A systems-oriented mindset and the ability to quickly learn complex revenue structures, including multiple commission plans, territories, splits, and crediting rules.

Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience supporting commission administration and sales compensation processes.

  • Experience supporting financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and board-level reporting at a growing SaaS company.

  • A demonstrated interest in process improvement, spreadsheet automation, and building scalable financial reporting workflows.

Why Join Us:
Here at Transfr we are creating an engaging and interactive learning experience that help people gain real-world skills and unlock new career opportunities. We’re on a mission to make learning more intuitive, empowering, and fun and we are looking for people who are excited to help others grow, succeed, and thrive.

If you’re excited about blending creativity, technology, and meaningful impact, you’ll feel right at home here. Join us in building pathways to prosperity by creating immersive training simulations that prepare people for well-paying, in-demand careers and help make opportunity more accessible for everyone.

Benefits:

Medical, dental, and vision insurance

Annual professional development budget for each individual

401(k) savings plan

Life, AD&D, and disability insurance coverage

Company-provided laptop and other necessary equipment

Paid time off (PTO) to support work-life balance

Paid company holidays

Company-paid parental leave

Flexible work arrangements in a remote-first environment with employees across the U.S.

About Us

Transfr is on a mission to help create pathways to career success. Our immersive career exploration and training simulations empower learners and job seekers of all ages find the right job for them and build the skills they need to enter (or reenter) the workforce or change careers — helping them improve their quality of life. Immersive VR experiences from Transfr have been shown in studies to deliver better learning gains than video tutorials, slide presentations, and other training methods. Learners also find Transfr experiences highly engaging and enjoyable. At Transfr, we believe the future starts with innovative workplace training and skills development. We’re building bridges between schools, workplaces, and governments to help improve training and job placement pipelines and create a better tomorrow, today.
